name: Neon Cyber
tagline: dashi's 霓虹赛博: a violet night sky, magenta and cyan accent words, electric yellow warnings, HUD lines and CRT transitions.

motion.direction: dashi neon cyber. A night gradient (`stage` → violet `mar`), lavender HUD lines, magenta `ter` as accent A and cyan `goldd` as accent B on the two core nouns, electric yellow `gold` only for warnings; Space Grotesk display with a soft glow, mono readouts, a city-silhouette feel. Entrances blur in 0.2–0.45 s, CRT open / close and scanline wipes between sections (≤ 0.2 s glitch, white flashes ≥ 6 s apart), slow push 1–1.5 %/s. A / B words get solid colour blocks in the captions. Something new every 2–3 s, a big change every 3–5 s.
